ns2:course.label: Viola
ns2:course.description: Instruction in viola at the undergraduate level. Music majors must register concurrently in MUS 250. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Passing of a performance audition is required prior to the initial registration in any applied music course.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Passing of a performance audition is required prior to the initial registration in any applied music course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Only open to students who have passed a qualifying audition. Non-music majors will be assessed a fee.
